'''Shachu''' was a giant warrior cursed by a witch in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology. "Shachu" was a popular name given to male Ewoks.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shachu was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" /> The name was later used as the name of randomly generated computer-controlled [[Ewok]] characters in the {{SW|url=play/online-games/ewok-village|text=Ewok Village|int=Ewok Village}} game on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="EV">{{SW|url=play/online-games/ewok-village|text=Ewok Village|int=Ewok Village}}</ref>
